name: CE_CP_OPTIONS_
description: This table contains the cash positioning and forecasting data extraction start date.

columns.name: CP_OPTION_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table.  A unique identifier of CE_CP_OPTIONS.

columns.name: BALANCE_DATE_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The number of days before a bank statement is reported missing for a bank account.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TRANSACTION_CALENDAR
columns.description: The calendar assigned to transactions used in cash positioning and forecasting.

columns.name: EXTRACTION_DURATION
columns.description: Duration in which the cash positioning and forecasting extraction will be taken.  For example, Last 2 years or Last 3 years.

columns.name: REPORTING_CURRENCY
columns.description: Reporting currency used by cash positioning and forecasting data extraction to convert and store the amount in the cube.

columns.name: BALANCE_CODE
columns.description: The reporting balance type code chosen by user. It is based on CE_INTERNAL_BALANCE_CODES lookup code.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REPORTING_CONVERSION_TYPE
columns.description: The conversion rate type used to convert cash postion fact amount from bank account currency to reporting currency.

columns.name: WEEKLY_EXTRACT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether weekly or monthly period frequency calendar is used to aggregate cash flows for Predictive Cash Forecasting.

columns.name: WEEKLY_CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the weekly accounting calendar. This attribute is used when weekly periodic forecast is selected. Null value indicates that user has selected monthly calendar.

columns.name: PCF_SETUP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the current record is defined for Predictive Cash Forecasting or Cash Positioning and Forecasting data extract options. This is an internal attribute.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
